visualReview.scope: Current portable geometry presentation; maximum architectural fidelity remains pending.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final portable/shared frames in the labeled contact sheet and full-size southern front, eastern facade and concourse funnel views. The six-part assembly retains the train sheds, clock front, ranges and concourse. Corrected inward-facing range windows, blank southern range ends, facade gaps, missing rear arch faces, overly dense funnel members and the suburban shed boundary. Unique mesh resources contain 132146 triangles; 192 mesh nodes instantiate 540926 triangles. No private bitmap textures are present. This approves source presentation only; the historic facade distinctions, concourse glazing/steel topology and site fit remain unfinished.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six canonical material graphs load once each; full instantiated geometry reaches the viewer, and unload releases geometry. PBR fallback remains available. Brick, metal, stone, slate, concrete and wood are shared. The source has no bitmap textures. This is an isolated asset fixture, not site approval.

geographicReview.notes: Inspected a native-axis overlay against the exact-QID OSM combined footprint. East/main-shed bounds align approximately; the suburban extension now follows the tapered boundary. The mapped curved outline fits a roughly 61 m radius while the engineering roof extent is 69 m. These may describe different envelopes. Separate roof/wall footprints, facade axis sign, datum and current site conditions remain to be resolved; no placement activated.

fidelityReview.notes: Primary engineering sections, plan, roof diagram and photographs inspected. Distinct Western Range facades and bomb gap, parcels atrium, booking hall, Roman clock numerals, lettering, glazing, exact roof meridian and diagrid, mezzanine, escalators, canopies and current geographic fit remain unfinished. This candidate is not counted complete.
